prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Robot, if object seen and reachable, move to it, grab, check, do task. Scan area, move repeatedly.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />     <Action ID = GrabObject    />     <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> </Sequence> <Sequence>     <Action ID = ApproachObject    />     <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ScanArea    /> <Action ID = MoveToNewArea    /> <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    />     <Action ID = CallAssistance    /> </Sequence> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			DO MoveToObject
	ELSE
		DO GrabObject
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
				DO CallAssistance
		END
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO SpecificTask
	END
